* S.K. Clark 09 June 94 1.2 Added total products available, instock,

*
* Abstract:
* This form allows an operator to enter an order for blood products
* into the Serve*Care system from export customers. An export
* customer is defined as any customer out of this institution.
*
* Error Conditions:
* 0000 -- transaction committed
* 0600 -- unsuccessful commit
* 1712 -- no attributes defined
* 0500 -- date must be greater than or equal to eff date
* 0501 -- eff date cannot be less than current date
* 0327 -- Invalid input, must be a-z
* 5308 -- must be zero or greater
* 1704 -- order has not been completed
* 0201 -- all required fields must be entered
* 0200 -- invalid function key
* 1200 -- orderer name must be entered
* 0302 -- invalid customer
* 0303 -- invalid contact
* 0304 -- invalid contact
* 1300 -- invalid consignee ID
* 1706 -- invalid order class
* 1708 -- no standing orders set up
* 1705 -- invalid order type
* 0235 -- product type and blood type must be ent
* 1711 -- item has been canceled
* 0309 -- invalid product code
* 0300 -- invalid blood type
* 1707 -- invalid quantity
* 1100 -- going below minimum
* 1101 -- going below optimum
* 0400 -- invalid price
* 0301 -- invalid attribute group
* 0305 -- invalid attribute code
* 1303 -- duplicate attribute
* 0236 -- duplicate record
* 1313 -- invalid charge_code
* 1311 -- invalid credit indicator
* 1312 -- invalid charge amount
* 0323 -- invalid contact type
* 1302 -- Customer ID already exists --
* 7304 -- invalid state code
* 0318 -- a 'y' or 'n' must be entered --
* 0325 -- invalid chapter ID
*
* Inputs:
* Reference the following data base tables:
* Orders
* Order_items
* Order_item_attributes
* order_charges
* vserv_contacts
* consignee
* customers
* vserv_contracts
* vserv_products
* product_pricing_matrix
* serv_note_books
* active_products
*
* Outputs:
* Update the following data base tables:
* Orders
* Order_items
* Order_item_attributes
* order_charges
* vserv_contacts
* consignee
* customers
* vserv_contracts
* serv_note_books
*
* Assumptions and Limitations:
* None.
*
* Modules Referenced
* srvlib
*
* Functional Descriptions:
*
* This form allows order entry for user at a blook bank taking orders
* over the telephone. It is not intended for querying, updating or
* deleting orders. It contains 2 major blocks and 7 minor blocks. The 2
* major blocks are:
* - orders: this block contains all info related to an order, the
* associated database table is orders. Customer info and order summary
* are maintained in this block.
* - items: this block contains infos related to order line items, the
* associated table is order_items. Line item product type, blood type
* quatity, tier and unit price are in this block.
* The 7 minor blocks are
* -- Contacts: uses table
* vserv_contacts: This block allows the insert of a new contact person
* or updating and existing contact.
* -- Customers: uses table
* customer: This block allows the insert of a new customer
* or updating and existing customer.
* -- Contracts: uses table
* vserv_contracts: This block allows the insert of a new contract
* or updating and existing contract.
* -- Consignee: uses table
* consignee: This block allows the insert of a new consignee
* or updating and existing consignee.
* -- Attributes: uses table
* attributes: info for special order line items such as
* product_attributes.
* -- Avail_products: uses table
* vserv_products: This block is used to validate product types.
* This block also displays product type, blood type, optimal
* and minimal inventory levels. Inventory levels table is also
* used to query inventory levels for a product
* -- Avail_tiers: uses table
* product_pricing_matrix: active_products:
* This block queries units
* based on product type, blood type, tier (from day - to day).
* It displays the number of products ordered, allocated, and available.
* inventory_level that contains inventory levels for a product
* -- Answer: uses table
* answer confirm block for backing out of an order
* -- serv_note_books: uses table
* serv_note_books which allows user to leave notes for that order
*
*****************************************************************************

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE select_customer_with_contract1
 (
 entry IN VARCHAR2
 ,include IN VARCHAR2
 ,cust_id OUT VARCHAR2
 ) 
IS
 --
 -- this procedure allows user to SELECT customer by entering a few
 -- leading characters of customer name, it will return the proper
 -- customer id or display a short list of matching customers
 --
 -- entry : user entry for search
 -- include : customer_types to be included
 -- cust_id : return customer_id
 --
 inlist VARCHAR2(100);
 chap_id VARCHAR2(4) := NAME_IN('GLOBAL.chapter_id');
 v_local_time DATE;
 v_local_date DATE;

 CURSOR c1
 (
 p_local_date IN DATE
 ) 
 IS 
 SELECT code
 FROM vserv_customer_type 
 WHERE p_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, p_local_date+1) 
 UNION 
 SELECT code
 FROM vserv_master 
 WHERE code_type = 'DCUST' AND 
 p_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, p_local_date+1) 
 ORDER BY 1;
BEGIN
 --

 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(chap_id,SYSDATE,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 ELSE
 v_local_date := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 

 -- set up list of customer types to be included
 IF include IS NULL
 THEN
 FOR c1rec IN c1(v_local_date)
 LOOP
 inlist :=inlist||c1rec.code||',';
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END loop;
 inlist :=''''||rtrim(inlist,',')||'''';
 -- inlist := 'AH,DI,EX,MG,PA,RD,RG'; -- all customer types
 ELSE
 inlist := include;
 END IF;
 --
 BEGIN
 SELECT customer_id 
 INTO cust_id
 FROM customers
 WHERE customer_id = entry AND 
 chapter_id = chap_id AND 
 INSTR(inlist,customer_type) > 0 AND 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,v_local_date+1) AND 
 EXISTS 
 (
 SELECT 'x' 
 FROM vserv_contracts 
 WHERE chapter_id = chap_id AND 
 customer_id = customers.customer_id AND 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,v_local_date+1)
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT customer_id 
 INTO cust_id
 FROM customers
 WHERE UPPER(name) LIKE entry ||'%' AND 
 INSTR(inlist,customer_type) > 0 AND 
 chapter_id = chap_id AND 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,v_local_date+1) AND 
 EXISTS 
 (
 SELECT 'x' 
 FROM vserv_contracts 
 WHERE chapter_id = chap_id AND 
 customer_id = customers.customer_id AND 
 v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,v_local_date+1)
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
 THEN
 cust_id := NULL;
 --list_values;
 END;
 END;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 tackle_error('Customers, Contracts');
 check_package_failure;
END;

 from order_items
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and order_no = :orders.order_no
